lines.text: Sarah dies at age 127 in Kiriath-arba, which is Hebron, and Abraham mourns and weeps for her.
Abraham calls himself a foreigner and asks the Hittites for a burial site, and they call him God's chosen one.
Abraham asks the Hittites to approach Ephron son of Zohar so he can buy the cave of Machpelah.
Ephron offers the field and cave as a gift at the city gate, but Abraham pays four hundred shekels of gold.
The field at Machpelah near Mamre is deeded to Abraham, who buries Sarah there in Shechem.

wrong_details.true: buries Sarah in the cave at Machpelah near Mamre (Hebron)
